summary: CytoMed Therapeutics Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing that its wholly-owned subsidiary, Advance Cancer Centre Pte. Ltd., changed its name to CytoMed International Pte. Ltd., effective May 6, 2026. The name change reflects the company's renewed focus on expanding its international footprint, including joint ventures, medical tourism, and overseas representatives, with an initial focus on Asia, particularly China. The subsidiary holds only a 19% equity interest in a licensed Malaysian clinic with an option to increase. No terms, consideration, or board recommendation are disclosed. This is a routine corporate name change and does not constitute a special situation.
